Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.qV9wP8xNSwIApkoZ]{14. The Shadow Court}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.gcuPKkoNXiQODqmB]{The Speaker}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.zoVBW5kGVZPRzEil]{First Ankou}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.I4vkTUYHQOBFYyIk]{Second Ankou}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.MNomD0F9znxZWEhs]{Third Ankou}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.yhpF1cCeoKCs3m1x]{Fourth Ankou}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.3dXFS236T6qdmn1F]{Spared Ankou}

Zone Zone 18: Thousand Voices (a grove of dead trees deep in the forest)
Hex 7.0 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Role-play (audience)
Threat Severe (140 XP) at party level 16 if it becomes a fight
Creatures Ankou assassin (level 17, Kingmaker), called the Speaker; 4 ankous (level 14, Bestiary 2)

Irovetti's map note. A ring of five dead trees drawn with grey cloaks hung from each branch. One cloak is coloured in solid black. Beneath, in a shaky hand: "they watched me. they let me leave." The note has no date.

Background. This grove is where Nyrissa's ankous gather between tasks. The PCs met an ankou at the Shadowless Lodge (#1), and this is that thread's payoff. The ankous have tested the PCs and found them worthy of a closer look. The Speaker summoned them here to take their measure for Nyrissa, the way a courtier inspects a gift before it reaches the throne. The ankous want information: what the PCs value, what they fear, and how they will rule. In return, they will answer some questions. Every answer they give, and every answer they get, reaches Nyrissa. If the PCs spared an ankou at the Shadowless Lodge, that ankou is here and remembers.

Arrival.

The trees here have been dead for a century, yet none has fallen. Grey cloaks hang from their branches like sleeping bats. As you step into the grove, the cloaks unfold. Five figures drop to the ground without a sound and settle in a ring around you, wings folded, eyeless faces turned your way. A voice speaks inside your head, dry as paper. "Sit. The Court will hear you."

Features.

  • The ring. Five dead trees around a clearing of grey moss. A stone table stands at its centre, laid with an untouched place setting for one.
  • The empty chair. A carved chair at the table's head, draped in black silk. Nobody sits in it. A PC who studies it (DC 38 Occultism or Religion) senses that it is kept ready for someone powerful who watches through it.
  • Dead canopy. Dim light throughout; creatures in the grove have concealment from anyone outside it.
  • Hanging cloaks. Dozens of empty ankou cloaks hang in the branches. Each marks a kill. One bears the badge of a Pitaxian scout.

Running the encounter.

Structure. The audience runs as an exchange. The Speaker asks a question; a PC answers; then the PCs may ask one question in return. The Court runs for five exchanges. Track the Court's Regard with the Influence block below. The ankous speak only through Telepathy.

The Court's questions. Pick or adapt:

  1. "What would you burn to keep your crown?"
  2. "Name the person in your realm you trust least."
  3. "If the forest asked for your kingdom, what would you ask in return?"
  4. "Which of you is the ruler, truly?"
  5. "What do you dream of on the longest night?"

Honest answers raise Regard. Lies raise it too if the liar succeeds at a DC 39 Deception check; the Court admires skilled liars. Every answer, true or false, reaches Nyrissa. Record what the PCs say: you can use it in Chapters 10 and 11.

Influence: the Speaker (ankou assassin, level 17)

  • Discovery DC 36 Perception; DC 34 Occultism or Nature (fey lore)
  • Influence Skills DC 38 Deception, DC 38 Diplomacy, DC 41 Intimidation, DC 36 Performance (the Court enjoys a well-told story), DC 36 Nature or Occultism (proper courtly etiquette of the First World)
  • Influence 3 The Court answers one question about Nyrissa truthfully: her name, that she rules from the House at the Edge of Time, or that she was once one of the Eldest's favourites.
  • Influence 5 The Speaker reveals that Nyrissa intends to absorb the PCs' kingdom into the First World once it is grand enough.
  • Influence 7 The Speaker gives the PCs a black feather. Showing it once to any ankou prevents that ankou from attacking for one encounter.
  • Resistances Threats provoke contempt (+2 DC on Intimidation). Mentioning the Lantern King makes the Speaker cold (+5 DC on the next check).
  • Weaknesses Answering a question with a story or a song (–2 DC on Performance). Showing a cloak or token taken from a spared ankou (–2 DC on all checks).
  • Penalty Attacking an ankou, refusing to answer twice, or failing two checks by 10 or more ends the audience. The Court attacks.

If it becomes a fight. The Speaker uses Shadow Doubles for three actions at once, flooding the grove with duplicates. The four ankous fly in pairs, flanking for Sneak Attack. They fight to drive the PCs from the grove and withdraw if the Speaker dies.

Outcomes.

  • Audience completed. The PCs learn about Nyrissa early, and she learns about them. Use their answers in Chapter 10.
  • Feather earned. One ankou encounter later in the campaign becomes a parley.
  • Fight. The Court scatters. Nyrissa's agents treat the PCs as enemies from then on; raise the DC of later fey social checks by 2.

Rewards. 140 XP for a full audience (Influence 5 or higher) or a fight; 80 XP for a partial one. Treasure: the Pitaxian scout's cloak hides a waxed packet holding 1,200 gp in gems and a scroll of a 7th-rank spell of your choice; the black feather (above). Kingdom: none, but the knowledge prepares the PCs for Chapter 10.

Scaling. For a weaker party, drop two ankous. At party level 18, add a second ankou assassin as the Speaker's second.
